steps.en: Install it and start the browser UI on localhost:8080
steps.zh: 安装后启动浏览器界面，监听 localhost:8080

steps.en: Point the client's proxy at it and install its CA from mitm.it once
steps.zh: 把客户端代理指向它，在 mitm.it 装一次 CA 证书

steps.en: Forges a certificate per site, decrypts TLS and records every flow
steps.zh: 为每个网站现场伪造证书，解密 TLS，记录每条流量

steps.en: Write a Python addon with a request/response hook and load it
steps.zh: 写一个带 request/response 钩子的 Python 插件并加载

steps.en: Calls your hook on every matching message so you can modify, block or replay it
steps.zh: 每条匹配的消息都调用你的钩子，可改、可拦、可重放

value.en: See and script a client's real encrypted traffic without changing the client's code
value.zh: 不改客户端一行代码，就能看清并脚本化处理它真实的加密流量

sources: https://docs.mitmproxy.org/stable/overview/installation/ (brew install --cask mitmproxy; uv tool install mitmproxy)
https://docs.mitmproxy.org/stable/overview/getting-started/ (mitmproxy / mitmweb / mitmdump; listens on http://localhost:8080; install CA via http://mitm.it)
https://docs.mitmproxy.org/stable/concepts/certificates/ (CA generated in ~/.mitmproxy, dummy certificate per visited site)
https://github.com/mitmproxy/mitmproxy/blob/main/examples/addons/anatomy.py (Run as follows: mitmproxy -s anatomy.py; request(flow) hook)
